subject: Intermittent 503s in us-west-2 — request for SLA confirmation
messages:
From: Matthew Li <matt@summapay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent 503s in us-west-2 (May 28)

Hi Karthik,

We started seeing elevated 503/429 responses against the Redwood generation endpoint for our us-west-2 region at ~09:13 PDT and it persisted in short bursts until ~09:18. Impact: several payment "authorization" flows timed out and we saw a spike in customer-facing failures.

I grabbed a few request IDs and a short sample of error responses (attached). Can you confirm whether this qualifies as a downtime window under our SLA and whether we should open a claim for credits? We also need a postmortem/RCAs for our compliance review.

Summary:
- Approx window: 2027-05-28 09:13:12 - 2027-05-28 09:18:07 PDT
- Symptom: 503 / 429 on /v1/generate, ~5-6 minutes of elevated error rate
- Sample request ids: see attachment summa_request_ids.txt
- Customer impact: failed card authorization attempts and a small number of retries that eventually succeeded

Please let me know the next steps and expected timeline for an evidence bundle + formal RCA.

Thanks,
Matthew Li
Ops Lead, SummaPay
Attachment: summa_request_ids.txt (text)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Li <matt@summapay.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:25:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s in us-west-2 (May 28)

Hi Matthew — thanks for the report and the request IDs. I'm escalating to SRE and will own the coordination for an SLA review.

Immediate next steps:
- I'll ask SRE to validate the window against our infra metrics and pull the raw routing logs for the interval you quoted.
- With your permission I'll pull and share a redacted log bundle (request IDs, routing decisions, instance health) back to you and to your compliance contact.
- Tentative timeline: initial evidence bundle within 48 hours; full RCA/postmortem within 7 business days. If this changes I'll update you.

Can you confirm the SummaPay account ID (internal) and whether it's okay for me to include billing@summapay.com on follow-ups?

I'll follow up shortly with the SRE findings.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:32:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Intermittent 503s in us-west-2 (May 28) — verify window and assemble evidence

Team — forwarding SummaPay's report. Details and asks:

What I need from SRE (please reply inline):
- Validate whether the window 2027-05-28T09:13:12-09:18:07 PDT shows a service availability gap that meets our SLA definition (please cite the metric and threshold used).
- Produce a raw log bundle (routing logs, instance health, autoscaler events, and the request/response traces) for that window. Name the bundle raw-log-bundle.tar.gz.
- If the window is eligible, provide the exact downtime start/end times you are using and an initial statement on recommended credit (per SLA: proportionate to affected minutes).
- If not eligible, provide the rationale (e.g., transient client-side retries, throttling due to tenant quota, regional routing fallback).

Related links: JIRA-INC-4821 (please attach the log bundle there) and Drive link for the evidence share. I'll reply to SummaPay with the initial confirmation once we have the raw bundle.

Thanks — Karthik

Attachment: summa_request_ids.txt

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intermittent 503s in us-west-2 (May 28) — verify window and assemble evidence

Karthik — quick update from SRE triage: we've pulled the routing and instance logs for us-west-2. Preliminary findings:

- Observed spike in 503 responses starting 2027-05-28T09:12:58 PDT and tailing off by 2027-05-28T09:18:03 PDT (consistent with SummaPay's sample).
- Root cause (initial): an autoscaler race during a control-plane deployment to the GPU pool caused ~6 minutes of elevated pod churn on the primary routing cluster in us-west-2. During the churn, a subset of routing nodes returned 503s while traffic was redistributed.
- Evidence: routing logs (usw2_routing_logs_20270528-0913-0918.ndjson), autoscaler events, and instance health markers included in raw-log-bundle.tar.gz. Request IDs in SummaPay's file map to the error windows in our logs.

SLO/SLA implication: by our SLA definition this qualifies as an availability incident for the affected region. I'll mark the incident Severity 2 and draft a compensation recommendation. Initial recommended downtime window to use for credit calculation: 2027-05-28T09:12:58-2027-05-28T09:18:03 PDT.

Next steps:
- I'll upload raw-log-bundle.tar.gz to the JIRA ticket (JIRA-INC-4821) and share the Drive link.
- Marissa, can you confirm whether we should route this to Billing for a pro-rated credit (and if so, whether we cap credits under the committed tier)?
- I'll start the RCA outline and circulate a postmortem-draft.md once we have a human-reviewed timeline and root cause analysis.

Soojin
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: usw2_routing_logs_20270528-0913-0918.ndjson, raw-log-bundle.tar.gz

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s in us-west-2 (May 28) — request for SLA confirmation

Hi Matthew — quick status update and confirmatory note.

What we can confirm now:
- SRE validated the window you reported. Our initial downtime window for SLA calculations is 2027-05-28T09:12:58-2027-05-28T09:18:03 PDT.
- Root cause (prelim): autoscaler race during a control-plane deployment in the us-west-2 GPU pool caused transient node churn and a short window of elevated 503s.
- We've uploaded an evidence bundle (raw-log-bundle.tar.gz) and the routing logs to our JIRA reference JIRA-INC-4821 and the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/incident-usw2-20270528.

Next steps and timeline:
- Billing: Marissa will confirm credit eligibility and amount; expected initial credit estimate within 48 hours.
- RCA: SRE will deliver a human-reviewed postmortem in ~7 business days; a draft will be shared earlier for internal review.
- If SummaPay would like an on-call walkthrough of the logs, we can set a 30-minute sync.

Let me know if billing@summapay.com should be the point to receive the formal credit notice. Apologies for the disruption — we're treating this as high priority.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Attachment: raw-log-bundle.tar.gz, postmortem-draft.md (pending)
